layers.authority: India's Ministry of Home Affairs and the Government of Arunachal Pradesh
layers.process: Reported: the whole state is a protected area for foreigners, who need a Protected Area Permit (around 30 days, with copies of visa, passport and photos). The Inner Line Permit is for Indian citizens.

sources.title: Protected and restricted area permit for India

zone-requirements.note: Confirm on the e-FRRO portal or with the state.
